system.description:
You collect a mass of water and impart chakra into it and begin to heal a willing creature you can touch with it. This dissolves the water being used into the healed creature as part of the healing process. Roll 2d10, healing the target creature by the total.

If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to also remove one of the following conditions; Bleed, Burned, Envenomed, Shocked or Weakened.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the healing by 1d10.
